newsitem.title: IRAN: SAfrica buys Iran's oil, sells it maize.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica buys Iran's oil, sells it maize.

text.p: South Africa buys 70 percent of its oil requirements from Iran annually, its ambassador to Tehran, Musa Mohammad Moula, was quoted by the official Iranian news agency IRNA as saying on Tuesday.
IRNA also quoted Moula as saying an agreement had been drawn up for the purchase by Iran of 700,000 tonnes of South African maize. He gave no timeframe or any other details.
Moula was speaking while on a visit to Isfahan, where he met officials to discuss expanding economic and commercial ties. He said his country was ready to cooperate, particularly in mining.

An Iranian oil official told Reuters on Monday Iran and South Africa were still interested in an oil storage arrangement that would give the Islamic republic access to strategic facilities at Saldanha Bay.
Iran is the world's third largest oil exporter.
